business_summary.text: Physicswallah is an online-first education platform offering test-prep and upskilling courses across online and offline formats, including Vidyapeeth centres.

call_points.text: Management guides for over 30% revenue growth and upwards of 100% EBITDA improvement in FY27.
Management reiterated commitment to achieve full-year PAT profitability for FY27.
Offline business losses narrowed to under -10% in FY26 from -19% in FY25, targeting break-even in FY27.
NBFC subsidiary FinZ disbursed ~₹200 Cr loans with under 1% NPA; ₹120 Cr equity infused.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company received an Assessment Order and Demand Order from the Income Tax Department on March 13, 2026, raising a tax demand of ₹263.34 crore. The Company filed a rectification application, pursuant to which the tax demand was reduced to ₹192.76 crore under an order passed under Section 154 of the Income-tax Act, 1961. The Company filed an appeal against the rectification order before the Joint Commissioner (Appeals)/Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) on April 13, 2026.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax, Circle5(2)(1), Noida, Income Tax Department
tax_litigation.status: Subsequent to filing the appeal on April 13, 2026, the Company filed an application for stay of the demand before the Principal Commissioner of Income Tax (PCIT) on April 20, 2026. Pursuant to the stay order, the Company has complied with the conditions prescribed therein. The appeal is currently pending and has not yet been listed for hearing.

operating_notes.text: Received tax demand of ₹263.34 Cr for AY23 treating investments as taxable income; company plans to appeal.
FinZ Finance received its RBI NBFC licence on September 2, 2025 and commenced operations in March 2026.
Vishwas Diwas collections were ₹200 Cr in one month, up 36% YoY.
Seat utilisation at 2x currently, guided to 2.25x steady state for Vidyapeeth.
Student-teacher ratio in offline at 80s, improving.
Online K-12 revenue rose 88% YoY to ₹105 Cr from ₹56 Cr, with enrolments up 41% from 0.55 million to 0.78 million.
Seat utilisation in Vidyapeeth rose from 1.77 to 1.99 historically, with 5-7% improvement expected each year.
School integrated programme partnerships grew from 15 schools to more than 50, and state boards operated rose from 7 to 14.

timeline.summary: Physicswallah filed its IPO Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 showing ₹481.91 Cr spent in the quarter and ₹2,332.41 Cr remaining unutilized.
Physicswallah Limited will host an earnings conference call on May 27, 2026, at 6:00 PM IST with **Mr. Alakh Pandey, Mr. Prateek Bhoob, and Mr. Amit Sachdeva** to discuss FY’26 financial results.
Physicswallah approved an investment of ₹120 Cr in wholly owned NBFC subsidiary FinZ Finance on a rights basis.

Physicswallah's Q4/FY26 earnings call (May 27, 2026) reported FY26 revenue of ₹3,900 Cr (+35% YoY) and pre-Ind AS EBITDA of ₹300 Cr (3x YoY), with FY27 guidance of >30% revenue growth and >100% EBITDA improvement.
